description: This is a shell script used for testing Git repository alternates and object count behaviors, involving repository creation, cloning, verification, and configuration of alternates.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository at a specified location and initializes it with an initial commit.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, executes a shell command group.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a shell command expected to fail, and marks the test accordingly.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output for test validation.
